title: Dragapult (Pokémon)
text:
Dragapult (Japanese: ドラパルト Dorapult) is a dual-type Dragon/Ghost Powerhouse Pokémon introduced in Generation VIII.
It evolves from Drakloak starting at level 60. It is the final form of Dreepy.


== Biology ==
Dragapult is a floating, teal, salamander-esque Pokémon. Dragapult's appearance is reminiscent of ancient lepospondyls, such as the Diplocaulus . Its head is large, triangular, and flat, resembling a stealth bomber pointing forwards. Its head is mostly a dark charcoal gray, with the front ends of the “wings” being a bright pinkish-red. On top of its head are four triangular “ports” resembling missile barrels that extend out the back of its head into a point. They are placed in groups of two on each wing, with the outside ports being slightly smaller than the inside ones. The front of these ports is bright pinkish-red, and the back is charcoal gray. The ports are equipped to launch out the Dreepy resting in them at top speeds. Its eyes are towards the front of its head. They are thin and yellow, with small black slit pupils and no irises. Its eyelids are red, and its eye sockets extend backwards in small hill-shapes on the top of its head. Its jaw on the underside is a pale yellow, with the color extending down the front side of its neck, chest, and belly. There are three upward-pointing pinkish-red boomerang shaped patterns on top of the yellow, resembling arrows on a runway or landing strip. It has a relatively short, pear-shaped body that fades from charcoal gray to bright teal the further down it goes. Its arms are charcoal gray held in a t-rex shape with four long pinkish-red fingers hanging down. It has two short teal legs with upturned feet and four long, pointed toes. Dragapult’s tail is the longest part of its design, being longer than the length of its head and body put together. It is long and salamander-esque, with a very thick base trailing into an invisible tail tip, likely in reference to its Ghost-typing. 
Dragapult carries a pair of Dreepy inside its horns, which it can fire out at its opponents like supersonic missiles by puffing up its cheeks with air. Apparently, these Dreepy eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds. This is evident by the fact that Dreepy always gather around the fastest Dragapult in their group to to fly at sonic speed. By clearing its mind and focusing, Dragapult can turn itself, as well as the Dreepy in its horns, invisible. As shown in the Pokémon Journeys: The Series episode Toying with your Motions!, its tail is capable of stretching out to great length when it uses moves like Dragon Tail.
Dragapult is the only known Pokémon capable of learning the move Dragon Darts.


=== Evolution ===
Dragapult evolves from Drakloak and is the final form of Dreepy.
(For specifics on this Pokémon's Evolution in the games, refer to Game data→Evolution data.)
